name: Packed Mass
description: Strike with a fist packed with the weight of stone and the pull that holds stone down.

name: Mantle Guard
description: Hold a guard made of stone's hardness and gravity's weight that nothing light can shift.

name: Strata Step
description: Step down through layers of added weight so that each pace sinks firm and stays.

name: Stratum Sense
description: Read the layers of the ground and the weight that each carries beneath the user's feet.

name: Clay Burden
description: Soften the ground to clay and add weight so the foe's feet sink in and are held.

name: Slide Pulse
description: Send a pulse of loosened stone and added weight sliding across the floor into all foes.

name: Sunken Ward
description: Sink a ward of stone into the ground before the user so blows are driven down into it.

name: Heavy Seam
description: Open a weighted seam in the floor beneath a foe's feet and drive a narrow spike up through it.

name: Pit Opening
description: Open a pit of crushing weight under a foe so that it sinks and cannot climb out.

name: Grave Pressure
description: Bear down with the weight of the whole ground on a wide area until all in it are pressed flat.

name: Foundation Crush
description: Drive the foundation of the ground upward and downward at once and crush all caught between.

name: Sinking Bedrock
description: streams: Gravity + Earth; the bedrock beneath a wide area is made to sink and crush everything above it.

name: Bent Palm
description: Strike a palm along a curved path so the blow comes at the foe from an unexpected side.

name: Curved Guard
description: Curve the path of an incoming blow round the guard as light curves round a heavy star.

name: Stretch Step
description: Stretch the distance ahead into a short bound that crosses far more than a pace.

name: Span Sense
description: Sense how distance bends near heavy bodies and where it is shortest or longest.

name: Dilated Pull
description: Stretch the pull between the user and a foe so that it cannot flee however far it runs.

name: Warp Strike
description: Strike through a fold in the space between fist and target so the blow lands with no travel.

name: Folded Ward
description: Fold the space before the user in layers so that a blow must cross it several times over.

name: Compression Wave
description: Compress the space round the user and loose it outward as a heavy shock on all near.

name: Collapsed Distance
description: Collapse the distance between the user and a foe to nothing so it cannot flee or leap.

name: Narrowing Space
description: Narrow the space about a foe until it can move nothing but its eyes.

name: Gravity Lens
description: Bend the path of an incoming technique round the user with a lens of heavy space.

name: Fold Crush
description: Fold a wide stretch of space upon itself and crush and pin everything between its folds.

name: Bent Distance
description: streams: Gravity + Space; the distance in a wide field is bent about the user so foes are drawn in and crushed.
